test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statement is INCORRECT?

options.text: All children will inherit a Y chromosome from their mother.
All human chromosomes are not paired.
Animals, such as snails, individuals can change sex.
Sex is determined by different factors in various species.

solution:
The correct answer is __**All children will inherit a Y chromosome from their mother.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Y chromosome is one of two sex chromosomes in humans, the other being the X chromosome.
 
• Females typically have two X chromosomes (XX), while males have one X and one Y chromosome (XY).
 
• Since females do not possess a Y chromosome, they cannot pass it on to their offspring.
 
• Only males can pass on a Y chromosome, determining the male sex of the offspring.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Human Chromosomes:**

 
 
• Humans have 23 pairs of chromosomes, totaling 46 chromosomes.
 
• 22 pairs are autosomes, and one pair is sex chromosomes (XX or XY).
 
 
 
• **Sex Determination in Animals:**
 
 
• In mammals, sex is determined by the presence of the Y chromosome.
 
• In birds, the ZW sex-determination system is used, where males are ZZ and females are ZW.
 
• Other animals, like some reptiles, use temperature-dependent sex determination.
 
 
 
• **Sequential Hermaphroditism:**
 
 
• Some animals, such as snails and certain fish, can change sex in response to environmental conditions or social structure.
 
• This process is known as sequential hermaphroditism.
